name: How do property taxes in Miami-Dade County compare to other parts of Florida?

mainEntity.name: How do property taxes in Miami-Dade County compare to other parts of Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property taxes in Miami-Dade County are assessed based on the property's just value and millage rates, which vary by municipality and taxing authority. While Florida does not have a state income tax, property taxes are a significant consideration. Miami-Dade's rates can be comparable to or higher than some other Florida counties, especially in more desirable coastal areas or newly developed communities. Kelby Contreras can provide current property tax estimates for specific properties in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties, allowing for a localized comparison.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property taxes in Miami-Dade County are based on value and millage rates, potentially higher than some other Florida counties. No state income tax applies in Florida.
